cases.task: Start with x=7. Apply x=(3*x+5) mod 97 exactly nine times. Return a short answer containing the token CORTEX-PILOT- followed immediately by the final integer.

Given (a,4), (b,7), (c,2), (d,9), sort by (value mod 3 ascending, value descending, label ascending). Compute the one-indexed weighted sum of the sorted values. Return a short answer containing CORTEX-PILOT- followed immediately by the sum.
